overview_description.description:
InstaShop is an online grocery shopping marketplace with a focus on making groceries easier for the everyday life of a consumer. It provides retailers access to an untapped revenue channel, while consumers gain access to convenient delivery from local grocery stores. The company enables users to shop at local supermarkets directly from mobile or computer and receive orders at home within minutes or at a scheduled time.

The company's goal is to provide people the opportunity to get groceries without the hassle and bring the supermarket right at home. InstaShop was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Dubai.
